subject: Co-hosted microsession with AcmeAI — invite plan, RSVP tiers & tracking
body:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Co-hosted microsession with AcmeAI — invite plan, RSVP tiers & tracking

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host the 45-minute microsession on LLM inference cost engineering (Dec 1, 2026). We wanted to share a pragmatic invite plan so we can land copy, segments, and tracking by EOD Tuesday. High-level asks below — can you confirm Acme's preferred VIP list and whether you want the two 1:1 follow-ups to be sent from your CSM or from the joint registry email?

Quick asks (for internal planning):
- Segment A (engineers): open invite email + two automated reminders (7d, 1d) with technical snippets and sample prompts.
- Segment B (product leads/pm): slightly higher-level copy, single reminder (2d).
- VIP wave: up to 12 names from Acme for personal outreach; suggested cadence: email + optional calendar hold from Acme exec.
- Tracking: we’ll use the attached utm-link-matrix.csv; final redirect links will live in shared Drive.
- Attachments: agenda (attached), invite HTML (attached).

Proposed deadlines:
- Tue 11/17 noon PT: finalize copy and subject lines
- Wed 11/18 EOD PT: send test send to internal/staging list; DRY run calendar link

Aisha — can you confirm VIP list by Monday 11/16 EOD PT? If Acme wants their branding lock earlier we’ll bump the timeline.

Thanks,
Jordan
--
Jordan Blake
Head of Events & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0192

-----
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@acmeai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Lee <devon.lee@acmeai.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-hosted microsession with AcmeAI — invite plan, RSVP tiers & tracking

Jordan,

This looks great — we can confirm a VIP list of 9 names (Devon will share). Prefer the 1:1 follow-ups originate from Acme execs if possible; our comms team wants the calendar holds to come from our domain so it shows up with our logo.

We're okay with the segmenting approach you outlined. A couple of notes:
- For Segment A (engineers) please include a short bullet showing a 5-node throughput example — our infra folks like concrete numbers.
- Can you add an option to opt into a 30-minute hands-on follow-up lab (limit 20 attendees) in the RSVP flow? We’ll promote that to VIPs and late-stage prospects.

I’ve attached two spreadsheets with VIP names and preferred exec senders (Devon will forward the file).

Aisha
Customer Success, AcmeAI

-----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-hosted microsession with AcmeAI — invite plan, RSVP tiers & tracking

Team —

Quick notes after reviewing Aisha’s ask:
- We should add a dedicated RSVP path for the hands-on lab (UTM=lab) and cap via registration form. VIPs get reserved seats by default and an opt-out checkbox.
- Subject-line experiments: 3 variants (technical, value-driven, exec-invite); we’ll AB test across Segment A/B.
- Link/Email send mapping: we need to make BrightStage send the actual mail blast (they handle deliverability) but the tracking needs to map back to our HubSpot campaign. Marissa, can you sync with BrightStage and confirm the SMTP/from-header setup?
- Proposed reminder cadence: for engineers (Seg A) -> 7d before (content nudge), 48h (case study highlight), 6h (calendar + join link). For product (Seg B) -> 48h, 6h.

Attaching the current utm-link-matrix.csv (draft) — please review copy placeholders.

Ben
Growth Marketing, Redwood Inference

-----
From: BrightStage Events <ops@brightstage.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-hosted microsession with AcmeAI — invite plan, RSVP tiers & tracking

Hi Marissa & Jordan,

Thanks for the brief. We can run the blast on Dec 1 schedule you outlined. A couple of logistics we need:
- Final from-address and SPF/DKIM proof (send us TXT records or confirm subdomain).
- Finalized HTML (we'll ingest partner-invite-html-v3.html).
- List segmentation CSV (we accept HubSpot export or a deduped CSV with one row per recipient and column 'segment').

We will provide a deliverability test to the staging list Wed 11/24 and a preview link for QA. If you want us to send the VIP personal calendar holds from Acme, we need the CalDAV/caller details by 11/19 EOD PT.

Cheers,
BrightStage Ops
ops@brightstage.com

[Attachment stubs: microsession-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda, speakers, 45m flow), utm-link-matrix.csv (UTM matrix draft), partner-invite-html-v3.html (responsive template)]
